params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: A bidding vehicle that is added step by step and finished later, on another device, comes back without its original owner, so the owner has to be picked a second time before the vehicle can be sent.

Source: Portal mail:59.

## What happens

A bidding vehicle was created on a laptop, at first without photos. The photos were added afterwards on a phone. When the vehicle was then sent from the phone, the original owner chosen on the laptop was gone and had to be added again.

## Why

While a vehicle is being added, every "Volgende" writes the step to the draft row (`VehicleForm::saveStep` → `draftColumns`), and the sheet says "Bewaard". `draftColumns` writes the wired keys that are columns of `vehicles`. The original owner is wired as `relation_name` (the display name, not a column); the column itself, `original_owner_id`, is not in that list. It is only written by the final save (`toBackendArray`). So a sheet that is left before "Wagen toevoegen" and reopened later, on any device, reads the draft row and finds no owner.

## Expected

The original owner chosen on the sheet is part of what "Volgende" saves, like every other field on that step.
params.title: Bidding vehicle loses its original owner when the sheet is left before the final save
